objectTypes.description: An empty container that parents other objects so they move or scale together.
A primitive 3D shape (box, sphere, cylinder, etc.). The most common object type for general geometry.
A grid overlay (cells and sections), typically on the ground plane.
A light source illuminating the scene. Choose the kind based on directionality and falloff.
A layout that arranges multiple image frames in 3D space.
Generative visual effects that add geometry or particles around a focal point.
A particle system arranged in a configurable shape. Use for swarms, sparks, dust, dotted shapes.
A 3D spline or path that other objects can follow.

allVariants.name: 2d text
allVariants.description: 2d 'bitmap' text

allVariants.name: 3d text
allVariants.description: 3d text

allVariants.name: advanced grid
allVariants.description: A Grid with shader material , animation and noise effects.

allVariants.name: arc
allVariants.description: Frames along an arc segment. Use for partial-curve panoramas, theater-row layouts.

allVariants.name: aura
allVariants.description: Soft pulsing glow shell around the object. Use for magical, mystical, holy effects.

allVariants.name: aurora
allVariants.description: Flowing color ribbons (northern lights). Use for polar, atmospheric, magical-curtain effects.

allVariants.name: basic grid
allVariants.description: Basic grid with cells and sections

allVariants.name: bioluminescentWake
allVariants.description: Bioluminescent plankton that flash when the water shears: swell orbits, excitable cells that tire and recover, moon glitter; the cursor is a hand, falling pebbles or a hunting fish. Use for night sea and fantasy scenes.

allVariants.name: blackHole
allVariants.description: A ray-traced Schwarzschild black hole: gravitational lensing, photon ring and a Doppler-beamed accretion disk with relativistic jets. Use for space, gravity and cosmic scenes.

allVariants.name: box
allVariants.description: Rectangular box / cube. Use for crates, walls, blocks, cubes.

allVariants.name: box
allVariants.description: Frames mounted on the inside or outside faces of a cube. Use for room-like installations.

allVariants.name: brownianDust
allVariants.description: Dust drifting in window light: Langevin motion in Kolmogorov turbulence, mullion shadows, forward scattering, glints and bokeh; the cursor is a hand, a torch or a charged rod. Use for interiors and cinematic scenes.

allVariants.name: bubbles
allVariants.description: Rising translucent spheres that pop. Use for underwater scenes, carbonation, magical effects.

allVariants.name: capsule
allVariants.description: Cylinder with hemispherical caps. Use for pills, character bodies, rounded poles.

allVariants.name: chladniGrid
allVariants.description: Vibrating Chladni plates: sand settles on the nodal lines of a standing wave that drifts between resonances. Use for sound, music, science and meditative floors.

allVariants.name: chladniSand
allVariants.description: Sand on an invisible vibrating plate: resonant plate modes throw grains onto the nodal lines, drawing Chladni figures that form and re-form; the cursor bows, touches or taps the plate. Use for science, sound and abstract scenes.

allVariants.name: circuit grid
allVariants.description: Beautifull circuit grid

allVariants.name: circular
allVariants.description: Frames arranged on a flat circle facing inward. Use for carousels, ceremonial arrangements.

allVariants.name: club
allVariants.description: Club mesh

allVariants.name: cone
allVariants.description: Pointed cone. Use for traffic cones, spires, ice-cream cones, witch hats.

allVariants.name: constellation
allVariants.description: Orbiting stars connected by faint lines, twinkling. Use for space, cosmic, network visuals.

allVariants.name: contour grid
allVariants.description: Dazzling contour grid

allVariants.name: cylinder
allVariants.description: Cylinder (pipe / tube / column). Use for poles, columns, cans, pipes.

allVariants.name: dandelionSeeds
allVariants.description: Dandelion seeds let go of the head one by one and drift away: a high-drag pappus gives them a slow terminal fall, and curl-noise wind with updrafts carries them. Use for meadow, summer, wish, gentle scenes.

allVariants.name: dataStream
allVariants.description: Spiraling particle stream flowing inward or outward. Use for sci-fi tech, energy flow, data viz.

allVariants.name: diamond
allVariants.description: Diamond mesh

allVariants.name: directional
allVariants.description: Parallel rays from one direction (like the sun). Use for sunlight, moonlight, key light.

allVariants.name: dnaHelix
allVariants.description: Double/triple strand helix of particles. Use for biology, genetics, twisted-strand visuals.

allVariants.name: dodecahedron
allVariants.description: 12-sided polyhedron with pentagonal faces. Use for d12 dice, faceted gemstones.

allVariants.name: droplet
allVariants.description: Droplet mesh

allVariants.name: earth
allVariants.description: Full earth component

allVariants.name: electronOrbitals
allVariants.description: A hydrogen electron cloud as Bohmian trajectories: a superposition of two orbitals breathing at the Bohr frequency, coloured by quantum phase; the cursor is a photon, a magnet or a detector. Use for science and tech scenes.

allVariants.name: fallingLeaves
allVariants.description: Leaves drifting past the object, each one integrating the Andersen-Pesavento-Wang falling-plate equations, so they flutter, glide and tumble like real leaves.

allVariants.name: fan
allVariants.description: Frames fanned out from a common origin. Use for splayed-card layouts, paper-fan visuals.

allVariants.name: faradayPowder
allVariants.description: Glowing powder on an invisible vibrating plate: acoustic streaming gathers it into swirling heaps at the antinodes, hotter where the plate moves most; the cursor bows, touches or taps the plate. Use for abstract, sound and fire-like scenes.

allVariants.name: fieldLines
allVariants.description: Analytic magnetic dipole field lines around the object, with trapped particles bouncing between mirror points like the Van Allen belts. Use for sci-fi planets, energy cores, magnetism.

allVariants.name: fire
allVariants.description: Flame particles rising upward with hot-to-cool color gradient. Use for fire, torches, flames.

allVariants.name: fireflySwarm
allVariants.description: Kuramoto-coupled fireflies drifting on a divergence-free flow: random blinking slowly locks into sync, with ripples of light rolling through the swarm. Use for night, garden, forest, magical scenes.

allVariants.name: flares
allVariants.description: Radiating lens flares with glow. Use for bright lights, magical shines, cinematic effects.

allVariants.name: flowNetGrid
allVariants.description: A potential-flow net around a cylinder: streamlines and equipotentials cross at right angles and bend around the obstacle. Use for aerodynamic, fluid and engineering floors.

allVariants.name: fluorescent
allVariants.description: A fluorescent tube

allVariants.name: forcefield
allVariants.description: Hex-pattern energy shield around the object. Use for shields, barriers, sci-fi protection.

allVariants.name: fractal grid
allVariants.description: Fractal base grid

allVariants.name: galaxy
allVariants.description: A spiral galaxy from density-wave theory: nested elliptical orbits twist into arms, lit by young blue stars, dust lanes and a warm bulge. Use for space, cosmic, sci-fi scenes.

allVariants.name: gear
allVariants.description: Gear shape mesh

allVariants.name: girihGrid
allVariants.description: Islamic star-and-rosette strapwork built by Hankin polygons-in-contact: rays leave every edge midpoint at the contact angle and close into interlaced stars. Use for ornament, palace, mosaic and ritual floors.

allVariants.name: glyphs
allVariants.description: Floating symbols or runes circling the object. Use for magic, arcane, mystical effects.

allVariants.name: gravWaveGrid
allVariants.description: A spacetime lattice around an inspiralling black-hole binary: the wells pinch the grid and chirping quadrupole waves spiral outward until the merger rings down. Use for space, physics and sci-fi floors.

allVariants.name: grinderSparks
allVariants.description: Slow-motion grinder sparks: drag-limited ballistics, radiative cooling on the blackbody scale, carbon bursts, floor bounces and reflections; the cursor moves the grinder, aims the spray or sweeps the air. Use for industrial and cinematic scenes.

allVariants.name: harmonicShell
allVariants.description: An iridescent soap-film shell shaped by morphing spherical harmonics, with glowing nodal lines. Use for energy shields, magic, vibration, organic sci-fi.

allVariants.name: heart
allVariants.description: simple heart mesh

allVariants.name: helix
allVariants.description: Frames spiraling vertically like a DNA strand. Use for tall, twisting columns of images.

allVariants.name: hex grid
allVariants.description: honeycomb grid

allVariants.name: hologram
allVariants.description: Scanline + glitch overlay. Use for futuristic UI, projections, sci-fi displays.

allVariants.name: horizontal
allVariants.description: Single horizontal line of frames. Use for film strips, timelines, horizontal showcases.

allVariants.name: hyperbolicGrid
allVariants.description: An Escher-style {p,q} tiling of the Poincaré disk that glides through itself; tiles shrink endlessly toward the rim. Use for mystical, mathematical and portal floors.

allVariants.name: iceCrystals
allVariants.description: Six-fold snow crystals grow as frost on the object, from hexagonal plates to feathery dendrites, with facets that glint and drifting diamond dust. Use for winter, frost, cold magic.

allVariants.name: iceHalo
allVariants.description: Atmospheric ice optics around the object as a light source: a dispersed 22° halo, sun dogs, a parhelic circle and a light pillar. Use for cold skies, suns, lamps, magic light.

allVariants.name: icosahedron
allVariants.description: 20-sided polyhedron. Use for d20 dice, geodesic forms, faceted gems.

allVariants.name: infinity
allVariants.description: Infinity mesh

allVariants.name: Led
allVariants.description: A let array

allVariants.name: lichtenberg
allVariants.description: A Lichtenberg figure grown by the dielectric breakdown model: a glowing fern of electricity creeps over the surface, holds, fades and regrows. Use for energy, sci-fi, power and lightning scenes.

allVariants.name: light bulb
allVariants.description: A bulb mesh with point light init

allVariants.name: lightning
allVariants.description: Branching electric bolts striking the object. Use for storms, electricity, tesla effects.

allVariants.name: lightning
allVariants.description: Lightning mesh

allVariants.name: magneticBottle
allVariants.description: Charged particles woven over any mesh shape: counter-rotating constant-bearing spirals that tighten into glowing tips, in two exact family colours; the cursor pinches, drifts or heats the orbits. Use for sci-fi and tech scenes.

allVariants.name: moire grid
allVariants.description: Moire

allVariants.name: molecules
allVariants.description: A molecule drawn as quantum electron clouds: hydrogen orbitals that morph from 1s to 4f, ligands arranged by the Thomson problem and bonding density. Use for chemistry, science, atomic visuals.

allVariants.name: murmuration
allVariants.description: A starling murmuration: thousands of boids with topological neighbours swirl around a drifting roost, folding into dense, wave-like sheets. Use for dusk, wildlife, flocking, atmospheric scenes.

allVariants.name: neonRain
allVariants.description: Night rain lit by neon: Marshall–Palmer drops at terminal velocity, gusting sheets, splash crowns and rim drips, each drop lit like a tiny lens; the cursor is an umbrella, a gust or a headlight. Use for city, noir and cinematic scenes.

allVariants.name: neuralNetwork
allVariants.description: Pulsing nodes connected by signal lines. Use for AI, brain, network visualizations.

allVariants.name: octahedron
allVariants.description: 8-sided polyhedron (two pyramids back-to-back). Use for d8 dice, crystals, faceted diamonds.

allVariants.name: orb
allVariants.description: Glowing sphere with layered shells and corona. Use for energy balls, plasma, magical orbs.

allVariants.name: paw print
allVariants.description: Dog paw print

allVariants.name: plane
allVariants.description: Flat 2D rectangle. Use for ground, floors, walls, screens, ceilings.

allVariants.name: planetaryRings
allVariants.description: A Saturn-like ring system: Keplerian shear shapes icy clumps, resonant moons open gaps and spiral density waves, and the planet casts a soft shadow. Use for planets, sci-fi, space scenes.

allVariants.name: point
allVariants.description: Omnidirectional light from a single point. Use for bulbs, lamps, candles, fires.

allVariants.name: point
allVariants.description: A rendered point (single vertex). Use for star markers, light positions, debug dots.

allVariants.name: polygon
allVariants.description: dynamic polygon

allVariants.name: portal
allVariants.description: A wormhole funnel shaped like Flamm's paraboloid: a lensed view into another universe, Keplerian swirl and infalling, blueshifting matter. Use for portals, sci-fi gates, rifts.

allVariants.name: pyramid
allVariants.description: Layered tapering layout, wide at the base. Use for hierarchies, leaderboards, monuments.

allVariants.name: quas grid
allVariants.description: Quas grid

allVariants.name: radar grid
allVariants.description: cool radar grid

allVariants.name: rain
allVariants.description: Dropping rain effect

allVariants.name: random
allVariants.description: Fully random positions and rotations. Use for fully unpredictable arrangements.

allVariants.name: reactionDiffusionGrid
allVariants.description: A living Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion field: coral, labyrinths and dividing spots grow across the plane and never settle. Use for organic, biological and alien floors.

allVariants.name: ring
allVariants.description: Flat ring (annulus). Use for halos, washers, planetary rings, dartboards.

allVariants.name: scattered
allVariants.description: Randomly positioned frames within a bounded volume. Use for organic or chaotic arrangements.

allVariants.name: shapeBurst
allVariants.description: Bursts of charged particles that spiral out in a magnetic field and land exactly on a mesh shape, white-hot cooling to two family colours, then dissolve; the cursor detonates, curls or pulls them. Use for reveals, logos and impact moments.

allVariants.name: shapeFlow
allVariants.description: A wind tunnel of particle streams flowing round an invisible mesh shape: divergence-free flow, wake eddies, streaklines coloured by pressure; the cursor is a second obstacle, a jet or a vortex. Use for tech, aero and product scenes.

allVariants.name: shield
allVariants.description: Shield mesh

allVariants.name: shockwave
allVariants.description: A Sedov–Taylor blast wave: a razor-bright front over a compressed shell that bursts out, slows and cools, raising dust and a brief condensation dome. Use for explosions, impacts, sci-fi pulses.

allVariants.name: shootingStars
allVariants.description: Add shooting stars

allVariants.name: smoke ribbon
allVariants.description: Smoke ribbon effect

allVariants.name: smokePlume
allVariants.description: A buoyant plume following Morton-Taylor-Turner theory, with curl-noise billows, lit puffs and an optional hot base and crosswind. Use for chimneys, fires, volcanoes, engines.

allVariants.name: smokeRing
allVariants.description: Physically simulated vortex rings: smoke spins around each core, rings slow as they grow, wobble with age, and pairs leapfrog through each other. Use for cannons, dragons, magic, calm loops.

allVariants.name: solarSystem
allVariants.description: Sun, planets and moons

allVariants.name: spade
allVariants.description: Spade mesh

allVariants.name: sparkle
allVariants.description: Sparkle mesh

allVariants.name: sparklesBurst
allVariants.description: Exploding burst of sparkling particles. Use for magical impacts, celebrations, starbursts.

allVariants.name: sphere
allVariants.description: Frames distributed on a sphere's surface. Use for planetarium-like or 360 layouts.

allVariants.name: sphere
allVariants.description: Round 3D sphere. Use for balls, planets, orbs, bubbles.

allVariants.name: spiral
allVariants.description: Frames following a flat or 3D spiral. Use for dramatic, hypnotic, fibonacci-like layouts.

allVariants.name: spot
allVariants.description: Cone-shaped beam from a point. Use for flashlights, stage spotlights, headlights, focused beams.

allVariants.name: Spot Beam
allVariants.description: Spot beam with beautiful configurable beams and light effect

allVariants.name: star
allVariants.description: star mesh

allVariants.name: stars
allVariants.description: Stars scattered in the sky

allVariants.name: strangeAttractor
allVariants.description: Glowing trails of a Lorenz, Aizawa or Thomas strange attractor, integrated with RK4; neighbouring strands drift apart. Use for chaos, science, data art, energy.

allVariants.name: super formula
allVariants.description: Super formula mesh

allVariants.name: tetrahedron
allVariants.description: 4-sided polyhedron (triangular pyramid). Use for d4 dice, simple pyramids, sharp spikes.

allVariants.name: tidalStream
allVariants.description: A spiral galaxy shredding dwarf satellites into tidal streams: symplectic orbits, density-wave arms, Doppler-shifted blackbody stars; the cursor is a subhalo, black hole or spectroscope. Use for space scenes.

allVariants.name: tiles
allVariants.description: Grid of evenly-spaced rows and columns. Default arrangement - neat and predictable.

allVariants.name: torus
allVariants.description: Donut shape — a ring with thickness. Use for donuts, rings, tubes-as-loops.

allVariants.name: tunnel
allVariants.description: Frames forming a cylindrical tunnel the camera can fly through. Use for immersive walk-throughs.

allVariants.name: tunnelPyramid
allVariants.description: A tunnel layout where each ring tapers - pyramid-shaped tunnel.

allVariants.name: tunnelWave
allVariants.description: A tunnel layout where the rings undulate - wavy tunnel.

allVariants.name: vertical
allVariants.description: Single vertical line of frames. Use for stacked feeds, scrolling columns, totem layouts.

allVariants.name: volumetricFog
allVariants.description: Ray-marched ground fog around the object: domain-warped density, Beer-Lambert light, self-shadowing and forward scattering toward the light. Use for mist, swamps, mystery, dawn.

allVariants.name: voronoid grid
allVariants.description: Voronoid grid

allVariants.name: wallpaperGrid
allVariants.description: Kaleidoscope patterns with the exact symmetry of the 17 wallpaper groups, drifting and cycling from one group to the next. Use for tiled, ornamental, crystal and mosaic floors.

allVariants.name: waterCaustics
allVariants.description: Sunlight refracted through a rippling water surface: Snell refraction focuses the light into a caustic web on the floor and over the object, with depth blur and chromatic fringes.

allVariants.name: wave
allVariants.description: Frames following a sinusoidal undulating surface. Use for flowing, ocean-like layouts.

templateObjects.description: A plane covering the sky with animated clouds material

templateObjects.description: a sphere with a moon texture and corona glow
